decisions.reason: As a relatively low-visibility add-on to the core radiant-heater business, it is easier to prune than the flagship lines, but another year of continued offering in a growing firm and market strengthens commitment to keep it.

This flagship multi-model electric infrared line remains closely tied to the firm's publicly stated lower-carbon direction, so accumulated investment and the need to justify that strategy strongly favor continuation.

Although less strategic than the flagship lines, it has now had sustained market presence and management can still attribute any weaker performance to temporary portfolio or demand effects, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
Its close fit with the firm's established industrial customer base and the deeper commitment implied by a full model range make management likely to continue supporting it rather than reverse course.

The hydrogen-capable line is highly visible, publicly linked to the firm's announced future, and already backed by a named real-world launch, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely.
